title: Senior Account Executive - Americas
description: 🌍 About Hopae At Hopae , we're building the world's most trusted digital identity platform — private, secure, and built for real life. We believe identity should be in your control — not locked behind outdated systems or centralized gatekeepers. Our product, Hopae Connect, lets businesses verify real people across borders through a single API — no need to build country-by-country integrations themselves. Our technology powers instant, privacy-first verification across fintech, credentials, supply chain, and gaming — for IDV providers, e-signature platforms, and enterprises who need identity to just work, everywhere. Backed by top global investors, Hopae operates across Seoul, Paris, Luxembourg, and San Francisco , bringing together exceptional talent from over 10 nationalities. We move fast, think globally, and build products that define the future of identity. 💡 Why You’ll Love It Here Global DNA: Work with exceptional peers across Seoul, Paris, and San Francisco High Impact: Build technology shaping the global trust and identity landscape Ownership Culture: No micromanagement — full trust, full accountability Elite Standards: Work fast, learn fast, and grow with world-class peers Inclusive & Respectful: 10+ nationalities, diverse perspectives, one vision Growth Mindset: Access mentorship, leadership visibility, and continuous learning This position is open only for candidates based in the US & LATAM 🎯 What You'll Do The Americas is where Hopae’s next wave of growth gets built. The US, Brazil, Mexico and Argentina are live on Hopae Connect, and demand is coming from three directions at once: IDV providers adding government eID coverage, eSignature platforms facing new compliance deadlines, and regulated industries that need to verify real people across borders. As Senior Account Executive, Americas, you own that territory end to end. You are accountable to revenue, not activity. • Own the full cycle . First conversation to signed contract: qualification, technical discovery, commercial structuring, negotiation, and close. No handoffs to hide behind. • Sell across all three of our buyer types. IDV’s, eSignature providers, and medium to large regulated industry players. You will learn to move between a platform integration conversation and a bank compliance conversation in the same week. • Sell the recurring motion, not just the one-time check. Our strongest accounts use eID verification for ongoing login and session assurance, not a single onboarding event. Building that story into every deal is a core part of the job. • Work direct and through resellers . A meaningful share of Americas revenue arrives through resellers whose own customers are the real relying party. You will also sell directly to large platform companies that need ID verification in many countries. (banks, casinos, crypto, ride share, etc.) • Partner with BDR and Marketing on pipeline . You will inherit a researched target list and a BDR to work with, and you are expected to self-source alongside it. • Run a credible technical sale . Work directly with Engineering and Product on integration scoping, sandbox evaluations, and production testing, so deals close on substance rather than enthusiasm. • Keep the forecast honest. Clean HubSpot hygiene, real stage discipline, and a number you stand behind. We would rather hear bad news early than good news that does not land. • Be the voice of the Americas internally. Which countries, rails and use cases you keep hearing about should shape what Hopae builds and where it goes next. 🧠 Who You Are • Experience: 6 to 8 years in B2B SaaS or API and infrastructure sales, with at least 3 years carrying a full-cycle quota on complex, multi-stakeholder deals. You have closed deals where legal, security and compliance all had a veto. • Market: Background in identity, KYC and AML, payments, fintech infrastructure, or reg tech. You understand why verifying a person in Brazil is a different problem from verifying one in Denmark. • Technical Credibility: Comfortable with API-first products. You can read documentation, run a discovery call with engineers in the room, and scope an integration without needing a solutions engineer on every call. • Territory & Language: Based in the Americas, with real coverage experience across the US and Latin America. Fluent in English is required; Spanish and/or Portuguese are a significant advantage for the LatAm side of the territory, but not required. • Commercial Range: Equally at home selling direct to an enterprise and selling through a reseller or platform partner, including deals where your customer’s customer is the one who actually needs the verification. • How You Work: Outcome-driven and self-directed. You set your own targets based on quota, hold yourself to them, and operate well across time zones in an async, global team. • Bonus: Experience with LatAm identity rails (INE, CPF, CNH, RENAPER), regulated-industry selling, or the eIDAS 2.0 and EUDI Wallet landscape. ⚡️ Fast Facts 💰 $13.5M+ raised from top global investors 📦 2.6M+ downloads of our sd-jwt-js library 🌍 10+ nationalities across 3 hubs 🔬 82 eID research projects completed 🌐 3 projects accepted into the OpenWallet Foundation 🎁 Benefits & Culture Unlimited PTO Remote-friendly work model Real ownership from Day 1 High-impact, global product Multicultural, respectful team 🧭 Interview Process Recruiter Intro Call (30 min) – Get to know Hopae Functional or Technical Interview (45 min) – Dive into your skills Culture Fit Conversation (45 min) – Collaboration & alignment Offer 🎉 Note: The process may vary slightly depending on the role. title: AI Product Engineer
description: What is Finary? We are on a mission to give power back to investors . Great financial guidance has always existed, it just came with a minimum net worth. We're changing that by building the AI-powered one-stop shop for investing, where you can track your assets, manage your budget, invest, and learn. One simple, ambitious idea drives us: put a private banker in everyone's pocket. Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1,000,000 people now trust us with their financial lives. We ship cutting-edge products with touches of delight, and we care deeply about experience, performance, and ease of use. Why now? A new generation of investors is emerging: ambitious, involved, done with taboos around money. We see a world where investing empowers everybody to live the life they've always dreamt of. To fuel that, we raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator, and Speedinvest, alongside founders and operators like Steve Anavi & Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (former UBS Chairman), and Harsh Sinha (CTO at Wise). In July 2026, the AMF granted us our MiCA license, on top of our Investment Firm license: one of the very few French platforms holding both, offering stocks, ETFs and crypto on a single regulated platform, right as Europe consolidates around licensed players. There's never been a more exciting time to join. What we offer We're 70 builders who genuinely love what they do: real ownership from day one, tier-1 salary and equity, offices in the heart of Paris with hybrid remote, and quarterly gatherings we actually look forward to. We hire A-players who are as kind as they are demanding, people whose ideas transform not just our product but the way we work and think. Our culture is direct, transparent, and built on radical candor: we challenge each other openly, then commit. And we don't hedge on AI. It's the single most important skill of the next decade and a real bar here. Everyone at Finary has rebuilt how they work around it. If that's already second nature to you, you'll be surrounded by people pushing that frontier every day. Read more about our values here . The opportunity AI is not a side project at Finary: it's how we intend to run the company. Our teams already build their own automations, so this role is about the hard part: complex orchestrations, and intelligence inside the products our advisors and operations team rely on every day. You own what you build end to end, from understanding the need with the people who'll use it to running it in production. We move fast and need an AI product engineer to move with us. What you'll do Advisory at scale : build the closing machine and the systems that accelerate our sales team Allocation engines : build the recommendation engine that captures our advisors' expertise Operating systems : build the agentic layer that lets our operations team orchestrate a fleet of AI agents, with minimal humans interactions End-to-end ownership : gather needs with the teams who use your products, then design, build, deploy and maintain them; define what a correct agent decision looks like, measure it, and catch drift before users do Enablement : help non-engineers build their own automations, step in when they need something more robust, and work with the rest of engineering on shared agentic infrastructure What we're looking for Production software experience : 3+ years shipping production grade software, including products you've owned end to end, from gathering needs to running them AI systems in production : you've built and run LLM integrations, agents and multi-step orchestrations in production. You can explain how they work and evaluate them. You know when a simple rule beats an agent, and AI coding tools are part of your daily work. Range across the stack : comfortable across several languages and codebases, and quick to pick up new ones. Our stack is TypeScript, Rust and Ruby, on Google Cloud and Kubernetes with infrastructure as code. You don't need to be an SRE, but you deploy and run what you build and keep data correct as systems evolve Product sense and UX : you start from the problem, not the technology, and you care about the people using what you build and how it feels to use High agency : you work across teams and switch context often, and you find the next problem worth solving and own it without waiting to be told French and English : fluent French to work with our advisory team and the rest of the company, and professional English Based in Western Europe : we expect quarterly presence for our onsite weeks in Paris We're particularly interested in: An agentic system you built that is in production and used today How you know it works, and what it saves the people using it A time you chose a simple script or rule over an agent, and why Nice to have Familiarity with fintech or a regulated industry Passion for personal finance and investing What we offer Competitive salary: €65k - €80k base depending on experience, plus stock options Hybrid setup : teammates across France and Europe, with one week together in Paris every quarter (travel and accommodation covered) Closeness to your users : you're part of the Operations team, work across advisory, sales, operations and engineering, and have direct access to the people using what you build from day one High-performing environment : A-players who challenge you and help you grow Impact that compounds : what you build today makes every team more effective tomorrow Compensation: €65K – €80K • Offers Equity • Base salary €65K – €80K • Offers Equity Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
description: About Nebius : Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. The role As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Applied AI team at Nebius Token Factory, you will own model and endpoint optimization from model artifacts through production deployment. Your work will span model internals, quantization and model compression, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, inference engines, serving architecture, and benchmarking to improve latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and cost per token while preserving quality and reliability. You will work with kernel and platform engineers to investigate serving problems, compare configurations, and resolve performance and quality regressions. You will evaluate model- and engine-level optimizations together with distributed inference designs, including request routing, scheduling, prefill/decode coordination, and multi-node GPU execution. Your improvements will be validated through reproducible benchmarks and safe production rollouts under real-world workloads. Your responsibilities Own optimization projects for specific model families, customer endpoints, or serving backends. Compare inference engines and recommend serving configurations suited to individual workloads. Diagnose model-quality and performance regressions during production rollouts. Improve LLM and VLM endpoint latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token. Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, and NVIDIA Dynamo. Develop production model-compression workflows covering quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery. Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving. For prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD), evaluate KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and capacity balancing to determine which workloads benefit from the architecture. Design and improve LLM request routers and scheduling policies that balance worker utilization, queueing, request characteristics, and KV-cache locality while meeting latency and reliability targets. Scale dense and mixture-of-experts inference across multiple GPU nodes. Select and tune tensor, pipeline, data, and expert parallelism—including wide expert parallelism (WideEP)—with attention to hardware topology, expert load balance, and communication overhead. Build reproducible benchmark harnesses measuring TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token. Validate architecture choices under representative traffic and consistent GPU budgets. Collaborate with GPU kernel and platform engineers to trace bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers. Produce design documents, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations. Must-haves Strong engineering skills in Python and PyTorch. Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer inference. Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack, such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or an equivalent internal system. A strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks involving KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving. Ability to quantify trade-offs among latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost. Experience designing or optimizing distributed inference system architecture, with hands-on work in one or more areas such as request routing, distributed scheduling, PDD, multi-node inference, or expert parallelism. Strong communication and collaboration skills across research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams. Nice-to-haves Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8, INT8, INT4, NVFP4, MXFP4, AWQ, GPTQ, or SmoothQuant. Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or related inference acceleration methods. Experience supporting agentic workloads involving tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration. Familiarity with CUDA or Triton; the role does not require kernel engineering to be the candidate’s primary specialization. Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, PyTorch, Triton, Ray, or KServe. Implementation experience with cache-aware request routing, PDD, or WideEP, including diagnosing communication bottlenecks and load imbalance. Familiarity with GPU communication libraries and interconnects, such as NCCL, NVLink, InfiniBand, or RoCE. In this role, you will lead analysis on some of our most important growth questions. A key part of the role will be helping teams make better growth and investment decisions. Key responsibilities Drive end-to-end analysis on priority growth questions, from problem definition through to recommendation and measurement. Proactively identify and investigate changes in growth performance, including the key drivers, risks and opportunities behind them, rather than waiting for questions to be handed over. Build scalable analytical approaches that improve the speed, consistency and quality of decision-making. Strong understanding of growth, customer acquisition, funnel performance and the interaction between Marketing and Product. Experience analysing customer journeys across multiple stages of the funnel, including cohort behaviour, lifecycle performance and longer conversion or nurturing journeys. Good knowledge of marketing effectiveness approaches such as MMM, incrementality testing, experimentation and attribution. Proven ability to independently structure and lead complex or ambiguous analytical work. Strong commercial judgement and the ability to move from analysis to clear recommendations. Comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor, influencing without authority and partnering closely with leadership teams. Flexible and open-minded, able to thrive in a fast-moving, evolving environment. Clear, confident communicator with strong written and verbal presentation skills. Tools and technical skills Advanced SQL. You're not reaching for documentation for standard analytical patterns Familiarity with analytical tools and languages such as Python or R. Experience working with marketing and experimentation data from major digital platforms and internal data warehouses (we use Databricks). Practical understanding of advanced measurement methodologies and their limitations in real-world decision-making. title: Lead RN, Utilization Management
description: At Clover Health , we are committed to providing high-quality, affordable, and easy-to-understand healthcare plans for America’s seniors. The Utilization Management (UM) team plays a vital role in supporting Clover members throughout their care journey. The team is made up of experienced clinicians who combine clinical expertise with data-driven insights to support evidence-based decision-making. Working closely with providers and care partners, the UM team ensures that care transitions are smooth, efficient, and always focused on improving member outcomes while maintaining compliance with CMS guidelines. As the Lead RN, Utilization Management, you will coach and develop clinical staff, oversee daily review operations, and monitor quality and vendor performance. You will partner with Medical Directors and teams across Clover to strengthen review consistency and improve workflows. The ideal candidate brings sound clinical judgment, strong leadership skills, and a commitment to putting members first. As a Lead RN, Utilization Management, you will: Lead, coach, and onboard Utilization Management nurses and clinical reviewers; use case audits and feedback to support staff development and accountability. Manage daily workloads, staffing coverage, and escalations across prospective, concurrent, and retrospective reviews. Oversee vendor contracting, implementation, performance, and delegation; monitor trends, turnaround times, productivity, and quality, and implement corrective actions. You put members first and bring sound clinical judgment, clear communication, and collaboration to complex decisions. You should get in touch if: You hold an active, unrestricted RN license Bachelor of Science in Nursing or equivalent relevant experience. You have at least five years of clinical nursing experience and three years in health plan, managed care, or utilization management settings. You have experience leading, supervising, or mentoring clinical staff and strong coaching, communication, critical-thinking, and conflict-resolution skills. You understand medical-necessity review and clinical documentation, have applied InterQual or MCG criteria, and have working knowledge of Medicare Advantage and applicable CMS requirements. title: General Manager, SMB - US-Based
description: Job Summary: As General Manager, Small & Medium Business (SMB), reporting directly to the EVP, Industries, you will own the strategy, growth, and profitability of Toptal ’s SMB business, with full P&L and budget authority. You will improve how we win new clients, retain and expand existing relationships, and bring more of Toptal’s capabilities to market. You will decide where to invest, build the team, and be accountable for the results. SMB requires consistent and strong commercial judgment at a high volume. New clients arrive with an immediate need; within 15 minutes your team must quickly understand the problem, explain how Toptal can help, and move the opportunity toward a sale. In addition to strengthening the inbound execution, you will grow our nascent outbound sales motion, improve our client expansion motion, develop more targeted marketing with our Enterprise industry teams, and activate a partnership ecosystem to bring new clients and revenue to Toptal. You will lead a high-energy sales organization with clear expectations and rigorous performance management. You will listen to calls, speak with clients, examine where opportunities are lost, and coach your leaders through specific performance issues. You will know whether a shortfall comes from demand, selling quality, pricing, capacity, or the client experience, and act with the responsible teams to address it. Your managers should see the standard you expect in your own work. You will build on an established client base and inbound demand to expand the problems small and medium-sized businesses trust Toptal to solve through our services, AI-based solutions, and talent-based capabilities. You will have the authority to build the team and invest in profitable growth. This is a remote position. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. Set and execute the SMB strategy. Identify the client needs, offerings, and sales approaches with the strongest growth potential. Build a business plan with clear financial objectives, priorities, and investment choices. Strengthen the existing talent business while developing additional sources of growth. Own the P&L and budget. Be accountable for revenue, profitability, and spending. Understand how conversion, retention, pricing, offering mix, and the cost to acquire and serve clients affect results. Allocate resources, evaluate returns, and act when performance diverges from the plan. Improve conversion from first contact to first engagement. Set clear standards for response speed, discovery, qualification, and closing. Ensure sellers maintain ownership as specialists resolve technical questions and clients move through the buying process. Find where momentum is lost and address the underlying causes. Grow and retain the client base. Build an account management approach that gives clients appropriate attention based on their needs and potential. Expect proactive conversations about upcoming work, engagement outcomes, and opportunities to do more with Toptal. Address reasons clients leave and develop practical ways to earn repeat business. Build outbound sales and targeted marketing. Grow the nascent outbound motion into a repeatable source of revenue. Work with Marketing, Sales Development, and Enterprise industry teams to select target clients, develop relevant propositions, and run coordinated campaigns. Use shared industry insight and client experience to sharpen targeting, then assess results through conversion, revenue, and acquisition economics. Activate a partnership ecosystem. Build partnerships that create qualified demand and new revenue for SMB. Identify and recruit the right partners, equip them to sell with Toptal, and develop joint plans with clear opportunity ownership. Turn promising relationships into active referral, co-selling, or resale motions, and invest in those that produce profitable growth. Expand adoption of services and AI-based solutions. Help sellers recognize when a client’s needs extend beyond an individual talent request. Work with Services leaders and specialists to develop relevant propositions, bring expertise into client conversations, and close business. Build the team’s ability to sell broader solutions while maintaining progress on the client’s immediate need. Build a high-performing sales organization. Recruit strong managers and sellers, set demanding but achievable expectations, and establish a daily and weekly rhythm for performance management. Hold managers accountable for call quality, conversion, productivity, and commercial results. Review their coaching, demonstrate stronger approaches, recognize strong performance, and address underperformance promptly. Match capacity and coverage to the work. Plan staffing around demand, response expectations, active opportunities, and account needs. Give teams clear ownership and workable client portfolios. Coordinate with Operations, Matching, and Delivery so internal transitions preserve context and keep clients moving forward. Run the business with reliable evidence. Establish a consistent view of acquisition, engagement starts, retention, expansion, seller productivity, and financial performance. Build forecasts that reflect the speed and volume of SMB sales. Test changes against clear baselines, distinguish temporary movement from sustained improvement, and use technology and AI to improve execution. In the first week, expect to: Learn Toptal’s business model, capabilities, SMB sales process, and client value proposition. Meet your leadership team and the functions supporting acquisition, account management, partnerships, matching, and delivery. Listen to client calls and begin reviewing the funnel, client portfolio, P&L, budget, and team performance, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. In the first month, expect to: Develop an informed view of where SMB wins, where clients lose momentum, and what limits growth. Assess your leaders and teams, including coaching, performance, capacity, and hiring priorities. Establish a consistent rhythm for commercial reviews, forecasting, financial management, and coaching. Present your proposed SMB business plan, including priority outbound campaigns, partnership opportunities, financial assumptions, and investment choices. In the first three months, expect to: Be executing an agreed business plan with clear objectives, resource allocations, and ownership. Have implemented initial improvements to conversion and retention, with baselines and a clear way to assess their impact. Be running targeted outbound campaigns with Marketing, Sales Development, and Enterprise industry teams, and activating initial partner opportunities. Have made the initial talent and leadership decisions needed to strengthen execution. In the first six months, expect to: Demonstrate measurable progress against the plan in revenue, profitability, conversion, and retention. Show that coaching and consistent performance management are improving seller and manager effectiveness. Show early commercial results from outbound campaigns and activated partners, with evidence to guide further investment. Manage the P&L against the budget and address material variances with specific actions. In the first year, expect to: Deliver against the agreed SMB revenue, profitability, and budget objectives. Have built a stronger leadership team with clear accountability, effective coaching, and consistent execution. Demonstrate sustained improvement in acquiring, retaining, and growing clients, including broader adoption of Toptal’s capabilities. Have established outbound sales and partnerships as measurable contributors to growth, with a clear plan for scaling them. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree is required. An MBA or a master’s degree in engineering, computer science, physics, or mathematics is preferred. 12+ years of B2B commercial experience, including SaaS or services sales, with a sustained record of scaling high-volume sales to small and medium-sized businesses. You can demonstrate your personal contribution to growth and improved commercial performance. 5+ years leading sales and account management teams, including experience managing managers. You have built high-energy teams, set clear performance standards, improved results through specific coaching, addressed underperformance, and developed future leaders. Experience leading both new-client acquisition and account management, with evidence of improving conversion, retention, and expansion. Demonstrated accountability for commercial results and resource decisions. You can explain how your choices on pricing, staffing, investment, and client coverage affected revenue and profitability. Experience building outbound sales and working with Marketing and Sales Development on targeted campaigns that produce measurable revenue. Experience activating commercial partnerships and turning partner relationships into qualified opportunities and revenue. Strong analytical judgment. You can trace a performance problem through the sales process, test competing explanations, and determine whether a change produced a meaningful improvement. The ability to improve a high-volume sales operation while introducing new offerings or ways of selling. You can make changes without losing control of daily execution. Sufficient fluency in technology, AI, and services delivery to discuss client priorities intelligently, evaluate commercial opportunities, and recognize when specialist expertise is needed. Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication. You can explain the business, make a compelling investment case, and give teams specific direction. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including proposals and presentations. Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do. Essential Job Functions: Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera. Work independently with minimal supervision. Use all required digital collaboration tools. Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines. Travel as needed to develop client and partner relationships and work with your team. US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off. title: Home Based Primary Care Physician (MD/DO)
description: Practice medicine where it can matter most: in the home. Clover Health is looking for exceptional, mission-driven physicians to join our field-based In-Home Care team. In this role, you will care for Medicare Advantage members with complex medical, functional, and social needs — many of whom are older, medically fragile, and at high risk for avoidable complications. This is not transactional care. This is relationship-centered, outcomes-driven medicine. As a Field-Based Staff Physician, you will be accountable for the health outcomes of a defined panel of members. You will meet patients where they are, understand the realities of their home environment, identify risks early, and help coordinate the right care at the right time. You will have the autonomy to practice thoughtfully, the support of an interdisciplinary team, and the technology to act with greater insight and precision. We are seeking physicians who are highly accountable, clinically strong, operationally effective, and deeply committed to doing what is best for vulnerable seniors. Why this role matters Many of the patients we serve are navigating multiple chronic conditions, recent hospitalizations, fragmented care, limited resources, and the challenges that come with aging. For these members, the home is often where the most important clinical information lives. In this role, you will have the opportunity to see the full picture: the medications on the kitchen table, the caregiver dynamics, the fall risks, the barriers to follow-up, and the early warning signs that may never surface in a clinic visit. Your work will directly influence whether members recover safely, remain stable, avoid unnecessary hospitalizations, close care gaps, and feel supported by a care team that genuinely knows them. What you’ll do As a Field-Based Staff Physician on Clover’s In-Home Care team, you will: Provide high-quality, patient-facing care in members’ homes across New Jersey Manage a panel of medically complex Medicare Advantage members and take full accountability for clinical outcomes Conduct comprehensive in-home assessments that evaluate medical, functional, behavioral, and social needs Lead post-discharge and transitional care visits to support safe recovery and reduce avoidable readmissions Identify changes in clinical status early and intervene proactively Manage chronic conditions, medication concerns, care gaps, and acute clinical needs within the home-based setting Build trusted relationships with members, caregivers, and families Collaborate closely with nurses, care title: General Manager, Industrial Products & Services - US Based
description: Job Summary: As General Manager, Industrial Products & Services (IPS), reporting directly to the EVP, Industries, you will own the strategy, growth, and profitability of Toptal ’s business across Automotive, Manufacturing, Agriculture, Oil & Gas, Chemical, and Logistics clients, with full P&L and budget authority. You will identify where we can win, decide where to invest, and build the team and client relationships to deliver sustained growth. Your mandate covers winning new enterprise clients, expanding existing relationships, and increasing the value clients receive from Toptal’s capabilities. You will bring a clear perspective on the challenges facing potential clients and where Toptal can help. Working with our Services leaders and subject matter experts, you will translate those challenges into viable sales proposals across our AI solutions, managed services, management consultancy, and talent offerings. You will choose which markets, accounts, and opportunities to pursue, allocate resources accordingly, and give your team a focused plan. You will lead from the front: personally leading executive client conversations, shaping proposals, working through difficult commercial negotiations, and helping close critical pursuits. Your team should see the selling standard you expect in your own work. You will understand what is driving performance, where growth is constrained, and what needs to change. You will build on established enterprise relationships to expand the problems clients trust Toptal to solve through our services, AI-based solutions, and talent-based capabilities. You will have the authority to build the team and invest in profitable growth. This is a remote position. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. Set and execute the industry strategy. Identify the markets, client problems, and offerings with the strongest growth potential. Build an IPS business plan with clear priorities, financial objectives, and investment decisions. Test your assumptions with clients and adjust the plan as evidence changes. Own the P&L and budget. Be accountable for revenue, profitability, and spending. Set and manage the budget, allocate resources, and evaluate returns on investments in people and growth initiatives. Understand how pricing, delivery economics, retention, and portfolio mix affect results, and act when performance diverges from the plan. Win new enterprise clients. Lead your team in pursuing priority accounts. Develop a credible reason for each client to engage with Toptal, build relationships with decision-makers, and personally advance important opportunities through discovery, solution development, negotiation, and close. Expand and retain client relationships. Work with Client Partners to understand client priorities, broaden relationships across buying centers, and develop opportunities across Toptal’s portfolio. Stay close to important engagements, resolve concerns with the responsible teams, and turn successful outcomes into further business. Make account planning actionable. Establish clear priorities and ownership. Expect your team to explain why an account matters, whom they need to engage, what opportunity they are pursuing, and how they will create progress. Ensure priority accounts receive sustained attention. Bring the right expertise into the sale. Work with Services leaders, solution architects, and specialists to diagnose needs and develop credible proposals across services, AI-based solutions, and talent. Coordinate with supporting functions to resolve obstacles and keep opportunities moving toward a decision. Maintain a credible forecast. Challenge the evidence behind opportunity values, close dates, and expected revenue. Understand the assumptions connecting the pipeline to the financial plan, identify risks early, and take specific action to address shortfalls. Build and develop the team. Recruit strong commercial talent, set clear expectations, and coach people through real client situations. Review calls, account plans, and active pursuits; demonstrate stronger approaches and follow through on improvements. Address underperformance promptly and develop future leaders. Accomplish work objectives through leading and supervising other Toptal team members on the Industrial Products and Services team. Establish objectives and initiatives for the team, recommend the team’s structure and jobs, and organize, assign, delegate, oversee, and monitor work. Coach and mentor team members, provide feedback, conduct performance reviews, and implement performance improvement plans, if needed. In the first week, expect to: Learn Toptal’s business model, capabilities, sales process, and client value proposition. Meet your team and the leaders whose functions support the IPS business. Begin reviewing the client portfolio, active opportunities, P&L, budget, and growth priorities. In the first month, expect to: Meet priority clients and develop an informed view of their needs, our relationships, and the opportunities ahead. Assess the team’s capabilities and identify immediate coaching, performance, and hiring priorities. Establish a consistent rhythm for account planning, opportunity reviews, forecasting, financial management, and coaching. Present your proposed IPS business plan, including priority markets and accounts, revenue and profitability assumptions, investment choices, and the first actions you will take. In the first three months, expect to: Be executing an agreed business plan with clear objectives, resource allocations, account priorities, and ownership. Be personally advancing major pursuits, helping close new business, and building qualified pipelines in priority accounts, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. Have specific expansion plans for key clients and be executing the talent decisions needed to strengthen the team. In the first six months, expect to: Demonstrate measurable commercial progress against the plan through closed new business, expansion revenue, and margin performance. Show that coaching, account planning, and opportunity reviews are improving seller performance and commercial results. Manage the P&L against the budget, address material variances, and refine investment priorities using evidence from sales and delivery outcomes. In the first year, expect to: Deliver against the agreed IPS revenue, profitability, and budget objectives. Have built a stronger team with clear accountability, consistent execution, and emerging leadership capability. Demonstrate deeper client relationships and broader adoption of Toptal’s services, AI-based solutions, and talent-based capabilities. Present the next stage of the industry business plan, including the investments required to sustain profitable growth. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree is required. Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred. 5+ years of proven success leading professional services sales teams specifically in Industrial Products and Services, with in-depth experience in the Energy Sector, specifically Oil & Gas is required. 12+ years of demonstrated experience running and managing an industry business unit with a strong understanding of business operations and management principles. Deep industry relationships ranging from director-level to C-level contacts is expected. A sustained record of leading enterprise SaaS or services sales teams, winning new clients, and expanding existing relationships. You can demonstrate your personal contribution to those results. Industry expertise and demonstrated sales experience in at least one of Oil & Gas, Industrial Manufacturing, Automotive, or Defense & Aerospace. Demonstrated accountability for commercial results and resource decisions. You can explain how your choices on pricing, hiring, investment, and account priorities affected revenue, margin, and profitability. Experience closing complex enterprise opportunities, including shaping a business case, coordinating technical expertise, navigating procurement, and negotiating commercial agreements. Strong industry relationships and a record of earning access to senior decision-makers through relevant insight and demonstrated value. Evidence of hiring strong sellers, improving individual and team performance through specific coaching, and developing future leaders. Disciplined qualification and forecasting skills. You distinguish client interest from a credible buying process, assess the evidence behind a forecast, and act when an opportunity loses momentum. Sufficient fluency in technology, AI, and services delivery to discuss client priorities intelligently and recognize when deeper specialist expertise is needed. Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication. You can turn a complex client problem into a compelling proposal and explain business performance without obscuring the issues. Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do. Essential Job Functions Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera. Work independently with minimal supervision. Use all required digital collaboration tools. Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines. US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off. title: Lead Data Scientist, AdTech
description: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz , All About Cookies , and OnlyInYourState . We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies. Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment. We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries. WHY JOIN US? You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato . BASE SALARY: $175,000 to $200,000 per year, paid semi-monthly YOUR ROLE You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS. Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time. We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own. By the end of your first year: Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier Carrier conversion data running in production models Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives Output the business trusts and uses without rework MUST HAVE 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify. You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view Expert Python and SQL NICE TO HAVES Real ad budget spent in live auctions Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker CI/CD deployment TOTAL COMPENSATION Base salary is set according to market rates for the nearest major metro and varies based on Launch Potato’s Levels Framework. Your compensation package includes a base salary, profit-sharing bonus, and competitive benefits. Launch Potato is a performance-driven company, which means once you are hired, future increases will be based on company and personal performance, not annual cost of living adjustments. Want to accelerate your career? Apply now! Since day one, we've been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: (766) Program Analyst
description: Company Summary Arlo Solutions (Arlo) is an information technology consulting services company that specializes in delivering technology solutions. Our reputation reflects the high quality of the talented Arlo Solutions team and the consultants working in partnership with our customers. Our mission is to understand and meet the needs of both our customers and consultants by delivering quality, value-added solutions. Our solutions are designed and managed to not only reduce costs, but to improve business processes, accelerate response time, improve services to end-users, and give our customers a competitive edge, now and into the future. Position Description: Arlo Solutions is supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Integrity and Compliance (OIC) in standing up and running the VHA Fraud Rapid Response Center ("VA War Room"). The War Room protects Veterans and taxpayer dollars through data analytics, fraud risk assessment and fast administrative action, in line with Executive Orders 14395 and 14243. The Program Analyst supports War Room operations and OIC's program integrity work. This person provides analytical, documentation and operational support for fraud, waste and abuse (FWA) lead and case development, fraud risk assessments, internal control reviews and quality audits. The analyst helps prepare weekly decision packages, maintains tracking registers and logs, drafts SOPs and reports, and supports governance and leadership reporting. The role is advisory and analytical. All final decisions stay with Government personnel. Location: Remote with On-Site Requirements Clearance: Public Trust Responsibilities and/or Success Factors: FWA Lead & Case Development Support: Help investigators and SMEs develop FWA leads and cases. Organize case documentation and evidence, and help assemble War Room referral packages. Case work is done only under Federal investigator direction. Weekly Decision Packages: Help prepare weekly analytic runs and decision-ready case packages that include facts, analysis, a recommendation and traceability. Tracking & Oversight: Keep the overpayment, recovery and referral status tracking register and the oversight and tracking support log up to date. Fraud Risk & Internal Controls Support: Support fraud risk assessments, internal control assessments, root cause analysis and remediation planning as tasked by OIC. Quality Audits & QA: Apply case-file QA checklists and sampling plans, and support quality reviews of workpapers and deliverables. Case Management Workflow: Help develop intake and triage SOPs, the case lifecycle and status taxonomy, and workflow process maps and RACI charts, aligned with CIRTS practices. Governance & Reporting: Prepare monthly governance and milestone reports, dashboards, outcome summaries and ad hoc white papers for VA leadership. Meeting & Stakeholder Support: Coordinate and document meetings with OIC, VHA and ERM stakeholders. Track action items and follow-ups. Training & Knowledge Transfer: Help develop training materials, templates and knowledge transfer content so VA staff can sustain War Room operations on their own. Flexibility: Must be able to work effectively in a fluid, dynamic, and fast-paced environment Minimum Qualifications Including Certificates: Able to pass a Tier 2 / Moderate Background Investigation (MBI) and get a VA PIV card Must be legally eligible to work in the United States Bachelor's degree 3-5 years of experience with federal healthcare program integrity or FWA work, such as fraud risk assessments, internal controls, quality audits, or case development support Strong analytical, research and documentation skills Experience preparing reports, briefings, SOPs and tracking tools for federal clients Advanced Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and SharePoint skills Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to handle short-turnaround requests Able to handle PHI and sensitive information under HIPAA and VA privacy requirements, and to complete the required VA TMS trainings Desired Qualifications: Experience with VA/VHA, CMS, Medicare or Medicaid programs Healthcare claims, payment integrity or improper payment experience Familiarity with the GAO Fraud Risk Framework, GAO Green Book and OMB Circular A-123 Experience with Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Experience with case management or compliance tracking systems (e.g., CIRTS) Familiarity with VA Community Care Familiarity with Palantir, Power BI, Tableau or similar analytics and reporting tools Process improvement experience (Lean, Six Sigma or kaizen) Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) or a related certification AAP Statement We are proud to be an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer and as such, we evaluate qualified candidates in full consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, and any other protected status.

title: Business Analyst, Clinical & Reimbursement Policy
description: At Clover Health , we’re focused on improving the health of our members by leveraging technology and data-driven insights to provide personalized, high-quality care. As a Medicare Advantage plan, we aim to empower our members by helping them navigate the complexities of healthcare and live healthier lives. We are passionate about making healthcare easier, more affordable, and more accessible for everyone. We are looking for an AI-forward Business Analyst, Clinical & Reimbursement Policy to serve as the strategic bridge between regulatory requirements and automated execution. In this high-impact role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of Clover’s clinical and reimbursement policies, ensuring they are accurately interpreted, regularly updated, and seamlessly integrated into our claims environment. You will act as a primary Subject Matter Expert (SME), translating complex Medicare guidelines—including National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs)—into actionable logic. You will also play a critical role in vendor management, partnering with external vendors to enhance policy oversight. Your mission is to accelerate Clover's transition toward a high-precision payment ecosystem where monitoring and research are highly automated, ensuring clinical and reimbursement policies are seamlessly and accurately operationalized. As a Business Analyst, Clinical & Reimbursement Policy, you will: Policy Lifecycle & Compliance: Own the accountability for the development and maintenance of clinical and reimbursement policies, ensuring perfect alignment with CMS regulations. Medicare Regulatory SME: Serve as the authority on Medicare guidelines, specifically interpreting and operationalizing NCDs, LCDs, and general national coding guidelines. Strategic Vendor Management: Serve as the primary oversight for external vendor performance regarding policy monitoring and accuracy. Hold partners to world-class standards through data-driven performance reviews and collaborative workflow design. AI-Driven Evolution: Lead the implementation of AI initiatives to automate the monitoring of reimbursement policies. Utilize advanced LLMs (such as Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT) to conduct regular deep research on ongoing industry trends. System Integration: Partner with the Configuration and Data Science teams to ensure that clinical and reimbursement policy intent is perfectly synchronized with technical adjudication. Cross-Functional Influence: Act as the strategic bridge between Clinical, Claims, and Compliance teams to ensure a unified vision of payment excellence. Success in this role looks like: By the end of your initial 90-day period: You will have established a recurring review framework and a comprehensive project plan for Clover's clinical and reimbursement policy library to ensure baseline quality and strict adherence to clinical guidelines. By 6 months: You will have ensured that all existing clinical and reimbursement policies are current and up to date, reflecting the latest regulatory requirements. You will also have implemented an AI-forward oversight framework that utilizes advanced research tools and early-detection monitoring to enhance accuracy within our adjudication systems. You will be actively leveraging AI tools like Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT to perform deep-dive research on industry trends and regulatory updates. Continued success: You will lead the evolution of Clover’s policy management into a proactive strategic powerhouse. By championing automated monitoring and data-driven research, you will ensure Clover’s payment ecosystem achieves market-leading precision and technological sophistication. You should get in touch if: You have 5+ years of experience in healthcare claims, configuration, or reimbursement policy, with a heavy emphasis on Medicare Advantage. You are extremely AI-forward and are passionate about how emerging technologies and LLMs (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, etc.) can be applied to drive operational precision in research and monitoring. You are a Medicare expert with a proven track record of interpreting and operationalizing complex clinical policies, NCDs, and LCDs. You have experience managing vendor relationships at a strategic level, ensuring external partners meet rigorous performance standards. Preferred qualifications include coding certifications such as CPC, CCS, COC, or CIC. You are a data-focused professional who builds strategy based on dashboards and trend analysis. You are familiar with enterprise claims engines and understand how these systems interact to drive adjudication accuracy. Benefits Overview: Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities Reimbursement for office setup expenses Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most. We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. #LI-REMOTE Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. title: Senior Security Engineer - SecOps
description: Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. About this team and role: Mozilla is looking for an Incident Responder to monitor and mitigate attacks across Mozilla’s products and services. In this position, you will be a part of a flexible team responsible for handling security incidents. As such, you’ll need to have years of practical security experience and knowledge of the state of the art for detecting and responding to attacks. You’ll be someone Mozillians across the company depend on and trust to respond quickly and effectively in a crunch, with the outstanding communication and collaboration skills needed to work in partnership with diverse stakeholders. Most importantly, you will become a critical member of the team responsible for ensuring the integrity of Mozilla’s products and for keeping Mozilla’s users safe, within a company dedicated to building a more secure internet. What you'll do: Identify and respond to security incidents on a global scale. Act as an incident commander to drive incidents through the entire response lifecycle. Design and maintain a portfolio of security alerts, automated actions, playbooks and escalation workflows in support of a high-performing 24/7 incident response capability. Conduct threat hunting activities, anticipate future threats, and maintain forward-thinking strategies for tools/technology/processes that combat sophisticated threat actors. Research threat intelligence reports, triage and manage resulting workflows. Partner with key stakeholders and communicate effectively to maintain a continuously improving feedback loop of preparation, identification, analysis, containment, and post mortem activities. Participate in on-call rotation. What you'll bring: 5+ years of demonstrated ability managing security incidents at a global scale and/or experience working in Security Operations Centers (SOC), Product Security Incident Response Teams (PSIRT), and Computer Security Incident Response Teams (CSIRT). Expertise with security information and event management (SIEM) systems (eg. ELK, Google BigQuery, Splunk, etc.). Splunk proficiency is preferred. Expertise with endpoint detection and investigation. Hands-on experience with leading EDR tools and demonstrated ability to leverage endpoint telemetry to find root cause. Expertise with security orchestration and automation (SOAR) platforms such as Tines or Splunk SOAR. Superb communication and leadership capacity; ability to partner effectively with diverse company stakeholders. Real-world experience in software development and/or engineering operations for consumer products and services; B.S. in a technology-focused field is helpful. Practical experience working with cloud technologies (eg. Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Services, Heroku, Microsoft Azure, etc.). Competencies: Ownership and Accountability Autonomy High Level of Integrity Clear Communication Creative Problem Solver Passionate about Security What you’ll get: Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday One-time home office stipend Annual professional development budget Quarterly well-being stipend Considerable paid parental leave Employee referral bonus program Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) About Mozilla Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online. title: Vulnerability Research Software Engineer
description: About Us Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. You’ll be at the forefront of supply chain security, creating patches for critical vulnerabilities and building the systems that help the entire open source ecosystem stay secure. This role emphasizes deep software engineering expertise, especially in Rust and Unix environments. You'll tackle challenging CLI work—scoping, troubleshooting, and addressing edge cases across multiple package managers. title: Sr. Manager, Data Engineering
description: At Veracyte , we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions. Our Values: We Seek A Better Way : We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward. We Make It Happen : We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way. We Are Stronger Together : We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team. We Care Deeply : We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another. The Position The Senior Manager, Data Engineering will manage an engineering team responsible for building and operating Veracyte’s enterprise data platforms. This role combines people leadership with direct technical ownership and is suited for someone who can move comfortably between architecture, implementation details, production operations, and team development. You will guide the evolution of modern data lake and lakehouse environments, delivering trusted and actionable data to scientific, clinical, operational, and commercial teams. You will partner closely with data science, analytics, product, clinical, software engineering, Security, and IT to translate business and scientific needs into secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions. This position is based in our San Diego office with a hybrid working model or may be US remote. Manage and develop a team of data engineers, supporting talent planning, hiring, coaching, performance management, career development, and team effectiveness. Remain close enough to the technical work to guide architecture, design reviews, code quality, troubleshooting, and key implementation decisions. Collaborate with business and scientific stakeholders to translate requirements into platform capabilities, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes. Help establish and maintain data platform standards, governance practices, architectural guidelines, and operational processes. Make pragmatic architectural decisions using AWS services such as S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda, IAM, and CloudWatch, and related technologies such as Snowflake. Support continuous improvement of engineering practices for CI/CD, automated testing, observability, lineage, documentation, security, privacy, and code quality. Partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Analytics, Data Science, Product, Clinical, Laboratory, Software Engineering, Security, and IT, to support shared goals and initiatives. Ensure data-platform security, regulatory compliance, privacy, and quality-management requirements are addressed through appropriate architecture, controls, tooling, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration. Drive platform delivery and operational excellence, helping ensure solutions meet business needs, performance expectations, and production reliability requirements. Balance delivery priorities, operational support, platform enhancements, technical debt reduction, vendor relationships, and resource considerations. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend adoption based on measurable improvements in maintainability, scalability, reliability, performance, security, and cost. Communicate technical decisions, alternatives, risks, recommendations, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and leaders across multiple functions, and build shared understanding in complex or sensitive situations. Partner with AI engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize opportunities for intelligent automation across the revenue cycle. Lead the development of AI-powered capabilities such as intelligent document processing, claims validation, exception handling, payer rule interpretation, coding assistance, workflow orchestration, and operational copilots. Design and implement integrations with enterprise platforms including ERP, CRM, laboratory information systems (LIS), electronic medical record (EMR/EHR) systems, clearinghouses, payer systems, and AI platforms. The person we want does not manage compliance by chasing people for screenshots. You will shape what GRC at Socket becomes. What You'll Do Own SOC 2 Type II end to end. Run the observation window, the auditor relationship, and the evidence pipeline behind both. Scope the audit and make sure the controls we describe are the controls that actually run. You own the report our customers read. Take Socket through ISO 27001 certification. Define the scope and the ISMS, run the gap assessment and internal audit, prepare the organization and get us certified. Enterprise customers are asking for this now. Then keep the ISMS alive as something the company uses rather than something the auditor visits. Make evidence collection continuous, automated, and boring. Write and maintain automation that pulls evidence directly from the systems of record: GCP, GitHub, our identity provider, MDM, ticketing. Build control monitoring that alerts on drift the day it happens instead of surfacing it the week before an audit. Every recurring manual task you inherit is a candidate for deletion. Turn risk management and vendor risk into working programs. Maintain a risk register that reflects the risks we actually carry and that leadership uses when making decisions. In partnership with our external security partner, run third party risk with real tiering, real reviews, and a renewal cadence that holds. Own the customer-facing assurance surface. Launch and maintain our trust portal, and build the library of artifacts that answers enterprise buyers before they send a spreadsheet. Measure your success by how much questionnaire load disappears, not by how quickly it gets processed. Scope our AI assurance posture. Our customers are shipping AI systems and so are we. Evaluate what matters: ISO/IEC 42001, emerging AI agent assurance standards such as AIUC-1, the EU AI Act, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework. Inform which of these to commit to, in what order, and what it would take. This is open ground and you will help decide what Socket does here. ISO 27001 depth. You have taken an organization through certification or run an ISMS through surveillance audits, and you know the difference between an ISMS that works and a binder that satisfies an auditor. You build automations. Comfortable building and maintaining automations against services. You do need to be someone who automates. Clear opinions about compliance platforms. You can tell the difference between a control gap that represents real risk and one that represents an auditor's formatting preference, and you spend the company's time accordingly. Writing that holds up in front of four audiences. Auditors, enterprise security reviewers, engineers, and executives. The instinct to step toward unowned problems, including the unglamorous seams between Security, Engineering, Legal, and Go-to-Market. Compliance at a company our size lives in those seams. Experience in a remote, fast-moving environment where priorities shift and nobody hands you a fully defined program.
