title: Container Engineer
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. More than 9 million developers and 250,000+ customers now build on Supabase, and the majority of new databases on the platform are created by AI app builders — so the systems underneath have to stay reliable while they grow fast. ABOUT THE ROLE Container Engineering (ConEng) owns the internal container platform that runs Supabase's multi-tenant, multi-region services — the managed Kubernetes platform that other engineering teams build and deploy on top of. We own cluster lifecycle and cluster classes, multi-cluster and multi-region topology, capacity, scheduling, isolation and runtime safety, the higher-level platform APIs, the Kubernetes deployment contract and Argo semantics, rollout primitives, and runtime configuration and secret injection. Your job is to make the platform itself trustworthy, observable, and cheap to operate at scale — and to raise the reliability bar for everyone who depends on it. This is not a gatekeeper role. You'll make the reliable path the easy path: building the automation and platform APIs that let product teams run safely by default, instrumenting what we operate, and making sure that when something breaks we detect it and recover fast. The work spans three strength areas: Tooling & ecosystem — deep knowledge of the container and orchestration landscape (Kubernetes, containerd/OCI, the CNCF ecosystem) and a clear point of view on how to compose it. Software engineering — designing and building the platform's automation, controllers, and internal tooling as production code, including solutions that don't come pre-shaped by an existing tool. Operational / SRE practice — the discipline (SLOs, error budgets, incident response, ORRs) that runs the platform at scale as a predictable one. We expect you to be genuinely deep in at least one of these, and many of our strongest candidates are deep in two (usually leaning toward one). Bringing real strength across all three is rare and exceptional — and even then, no one is equally strong in all three at once, so you'd focus where you're most needed at any given time. Different profiles are welcome here; tell us which of these is your center of gravity. WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR Regardless of the skill set, all team members carry a share of the team's on-call rota, responding to platform incidents and driving them to resolution and follow-up. Platform reliability & operations - Define SLIs/SLOs and error budgets for the container platform itself, and build error-budget policies that actually gate platform changes. - Own the Operational Readiness Review (ORR) process for new platform capabilities and major changes. - Design and track metrics for platform uptime, and increase observability into the platform by capturing the right metrics, logs, and traces across the platform layers. - Drive the incident-to-improvement pipeline: facilitate blameless postmortems, connect findings to readiness gaps, spot repeat failure patterns, and push through systemic fixes. Software engineering - Build and maintain the platform's automation, controllers, operators, and internal tooling — writing production code and shipping it, not just wiring together existing tools. - Design and implement the platform-side CI/CD and rollout primitives that speed up platform deployments while working within proper change and release management. - Implement and maintain security automation for the platform: intrusion detection, automated remediation, and patch management. - Identify and quantify operational toil, and build the automation that removes it rather than just documenting it. - Contribute to the platform's continual testing automation — the test suites and pipelines that validate platform releases are fit for purpose before they reach tenants. Tooling, ecosystem & architecture - Act as a platform reliability and architecture expert — contribute to failure-mode analysis, dependency mapping, and resilience design for multi-tenant container workloads. - Evaluate and evolve the platform's tooling ecosystem (orchestration, runtime, networking, isolation, and observability stack) with a clear, opinionated view on trade-offs. - Improve system architecture to reduce infrastructure cost while balancing security, reliability, and performance across tenants. - Guide teams building on the platform to design sustainable on-call practices for their own services: alert quality, escalation paths, runbook coverage, and noise reduction. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Have 5+ years in platform engineering, container/Kubernetes platform operations, SRE, or production infrastructure, and have operated production systems at scale and carried on-call for them. - Are genuinely deep in at least one — ideally two — of the three strength areas below (and tell us which is your center of gravity): - Tooling & ecosystem — know the container/orchestration landscape well: Kubernetes, containerd and the OCI/CRI standards, and the surrounding CNCF ecosystem (e.g. Argo CD/Argo Rollouts for GitOps and progressive delivery; Cilium/eBPF networking and the Gateway API; Karpenter/KEDA-style autoscaling; and workload-isolation runtimes such as gVisor or Kata Containers). You reason about trade-offs rather than reaching for defaults. - Software engineering — write real production code (Go and/or a comparable systems language) and can build controllers, operators, and platform APIs — stepping back to the underlying problem and building the right solution when no off-the-shelf tool fits. - Operational / SRE practice — are fluent in SLOs, error budgets, and operational KPIs; have led incident response and blameless postmortems; and have driven down MTTD/MTTR for systems you operated. - Have worked with large-scale multi-tenant systems and understand isolation as a spectrum — from namespaces, RBAC, network policies, and resource quotas through to stronger primitives such as virtual clusters (e.g. vCluster) or VM-class runtimes. - Operate confidently on AWS (multiple accounts, IAM, VPC) and are comfortable with infrastructure-as-code (Pulumi preferred; Terraform/CDK also fine) and Kubernetes. - Script and automate to eliminate toil rather than absorb it. - Communicate clearly with both infrastructure specialists and product engineers, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams. - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and iterating toward better systems over time. Nice to Have - Experience building and operating a multi-tenant Kubernetes platform that internal teams deploy onto. - Familiarity with policy engines (Kyverno, or OPA/Gatekeeper) and cost-attribution tooling (OpenCost/Kubecost) for per-tenant chargeback/showback. - Experience with managed database platforms or Postgres. - Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, or similar observability tooling. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

the Senior Manager of Application Security.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do </strong></h4> <ul> <li>Conduct and lead security research projects across multiple functional areas.</li> <li>Identify novel vulnerability types with the security community.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in security research, penetration testing, or offensive reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.</li> <li>Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.</li> <li>Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.</li> </ul> product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.</li> <li>Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.</li> <li>Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.</li> consistently forecast and report on deal progress and account health.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Drive organizations.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Shape the future of software development by crafting innovative solutions that align GitLab's platform with deployment.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Build deep, strategic partnerships by mastering your customers' industry landscape, success metrics, and break-words pl-2">Lead end-to-end customer journeys from initial discovery through evaluation, negotiation, and successful implementation, ensuring a consistent, high-quality experience at every stage of the sales cycle.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Champion continuous improvement by contributing to forecasting and pipeline reviews, conducting sophisticated win/loss analyses, and sharing strategic insights, including emerging trends in AI company buying behavior, that refine our go-to-market approach.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Prepare and deliver compelling customer-facing and internal presentations, proposals, and recommendations that clearly communicate value, business outcomes, and the path to long-term partnership with GitLab.</li> <li> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Experience driving complex B2B software sales cycles with enterprise customers, ideally in DevSecOps, software development tools, or adjacent SaaS solutions.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Background selling into large, enterprise accounts in San Francisco, United States, with the ability to build trusted C-level and senior stakeholder relationships across business and technical teams.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Familiarity with the AI/ML company landscape, including model providers, AI infrastructure vendors, and applied AI startups, and the ability to speak credibly to engineering and technical leadership about how DevSecOps practices apply to AI-driven development.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Knowledge of San Francisco's enterprise and AI market, including key industries, buying centers, and decision-making dynamics, with the ability to build and nurture a relevant professional network.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Ability to drive new business acquisition and expansion within enterprise accounts through consultative, multi-stakeholder sales motions that lead to sustainable, long-term customer partnerships.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Experience collaborating with channel and strategic partners to generate pipeline, co-sell, and support successful customer adoption.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead account strategy, influence internal and external stakeholders, and remain calm under pressure.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Ability to work in line with GitLab's values, use GitLab and Salesforce in your daily work, and travel as needed while following company travel policies.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Enterprise Sales team is responsible for driving business leaders, guiding them through GitLab-driven transformation and enabling them to become GitLab advocates.</li> <li value="5">Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration, continuous deployment, security, and cloud practices, challenging existing approaches to improve return on investment.</li> <li value="6">Serve as the voice of the customer with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing by sharing feedback, use cases, and competitive insights that inform roadmap and positioning.</li> <li value="7">Maintain and extend your technical expertise in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and related cloud technologies, creating reusable examples, best practice guidance, and technical collateral for customers and partners.</li> <li value="8">Invest in your own growth and development through ongoing learning, mentorship, and knowledge sharing to continuously improve the impact of the Solutions Architect team.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and continuous integration and continuous deployment workflows.</li> <li value="3">Hands-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, continuous integration and continuous deployment, and collaboration platforms, and the ability to map platform capabilities to customer use cases.</li> <li value="4">Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, with the ability to discuss deployment, security, and operations options with technical teams.</li> <li value="5">Ability to lead technical evaluations such as proofs of concept or proofs of value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.</li> <li Arabic.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives, with this role focused You'll work on the in-product journey from a user's first visit through sign-up, trial, and first purchase, on both GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab. You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Data Analysts, with a particular focus on backend development in Ruby on Rails and frontend work in Vue.js. This role gives you the opportunity to combine your fullstack engineering skills with product thinking and experimentation, shipping small changes quickly and measuring their impact on real customer outcomes.</p> <p><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/development/growth/">Some examples of our projects:</a></p> <ul> <li value="1">Making it easier for self-managed users to try and buy GitLab</li> <li value="2">Building upgrade prompts where users run into paid features</li> <li value="3">Improving the trial experience, including trials of GitLab Duo</li> <li value="4">Improving the tooling the team uses to run and read out experiments</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design, build, and iterate on A/B tests and experiments that increase first purchases on GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab.</li> <li value="2">Build and improve registration, trial, onboarding, and in-product upgrade and purchase experiences to increase completion of these steps.</li> <li value="3">Implement backend features and services in Ruby on Rails and frontend experiences using Vue.js.</li> <li value="4">Analyze experiment results and product usage data with Data Analysts to decide which changes to keep, iterate on, or roll back based on first-purchase outcomes.</li> <li value="5">Collaborate with Product Managers and UX Designers to define hypotheses and success metrics before shipping experiments, then compare results against those metrics.</li> <li value="6">Maintain and improve our experimentation framework and tooling to increase experiment throughput and reduce the time from setup to results.</li> <li value="7">Collaborate with other Engineering teams, including Fulfillment, to remove purchase barriers across GitLab’s codebase.</li> <li value="8">Document decisions, review code, and share experiment results asynchronously so distributed teammates can track shipped changes and their measured outcomes.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience developing with Ruby on Rails and modern JavaScript, along with solid Git, feature development, and deployment workflows.</li> <li value="2">Experience working with relational databases and a solid understanding of web performance optimization.</li> <li value="3">A track record of shipping features to production and owning them after release.</li> <li value="4">Ability to use product data to decide what to build, keep, or roll back.</li> <li value="5">Ability to document decisions and share updates asynchronously with distributed Product Management, UX, and Data teammates.</li> <li value="6">Ability to organize your work, seek and apply feedback, and collaborate inclusively with teammates from diverse backgrounds, in line with GitLab’s values.</li> <li value="7">Preferred, not required: experience with Vue.js, PostgreSQL, A/B testing, feature flags, experimentation frameworks, or SaaS sign-up, trial, billing, or checkout flows. We'll help you learn our tooling.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>We’re GitLab’s Growth team: one team with one roadmap, prioritizing work by how directly it helps people buy. description: Du bist Sebotics in deiner Region: Techniker/in und Organisator/in in einem – du installierst, betreust und machst uns lokal bekannt. Das Vertrauen, das der Verkauf am Telefon aufbaut, vertiefst du vor Ort. Deine Kunden liegen nah bei dir – du arbeitest beim Kunden, nicht im Auto. Service und Support: Wartung und Störungen vor Ort; eingehende Supporttickets deiner Region bearbeiten. LinkedIn) und bei lokalen Events und Vorführungen mithelfen. Lager und Weiterbildung: Regionallager betreuen, dich laufend weiterbilden, im Wiki mitschreiben. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>What does software planning look like when people and artificial intelligence agents work together? As a Staff Product Manager for Planning at GitLab, you'll help answer that question and lead the team toward a clear product direction. This isn't just about improving traditional agile planning. You'll rethink how intent becomes actionable work, how that work moves through software development, and where human involvement is needed.</p> <p>You'll develop a point of view on planning's future and turn it into product decisions with engineering, design, and product leadership. That includes exploring how planning could connect work to business priorities and budgets, rather than assuming the answer is already decided. Alongside that strategic work, you'll share ownership of existing planning capabilities with another product manager.</p> <p>We're opening this role at Staff level, with flexibility to consider Principal level based on your experience and scope of impact.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define a clear direction for planning as software development shifts toward collaboration between people and artificial intelligence agents, and help the team move from open questions to concrete priorities.</li> <li>Shape how users capture intent, break it into actionable work, and determine which work can proceed autonomously and which needs human involvement.</li> <li>Evaluate whether and how planning should connect software delivery to company priorities, business objectives, and budgets.</li> <li>Share ownership of planning capabilities, including work items, boards, specifications, and portfolio planning, with a fellow product manager. Help define how that scope is divided.</li> <li>Work with engineering and design to translate product direction into a roadmap and improvements to planning workflows across GitLab.</li> <li>Communicate your recommendations clearly to senior leaders, challenge assumptions constructively, and lead the team through changes in direction.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience leading product strategy and execution for software development, developer tools, or planning products, with the depth to make decisions in a specialized product area.</li> <li>A strong understanding of software development and development and operations (DevOps) workflows, including how planning decisions affect downstream delivery.</li> <li>The ability to form and defend a product point of view in an uncertain, changing market, while staying open to different ideas.</li> <li>Clear communication with technical teams and senior executives, including experience challenging leadership decisions constructively and building support for a direction.</li> <li>The ability to connect a forward-looking strategy to practical product decisions and work collaboratively across product, engineering, and design.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Planning team builds the capabilities at the start of GitLab's software development workflow, including work items, boards, specifications, and portfolio planning. Decisions here affect how work moves through the rest of the platform, so the team's scope extends beyond standalone project management tools.</p> <p>You'll work alongside another product manager and partner with engineering and design across this product area. The division of product ownership is still being shaped, and you'll help define it. The hiring manager wants you to bring a different perspective, question established approaches, and challenge senior leaders constructively, with room to influence decisions beyond your immediate product scope.</p> <p>GitLab's mission is to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. Our platform brings software development, security, and operations together.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Manager/Senior Manager, Solution Architects - San Francisco
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>Location: San Francisco, California </h2> <h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As the Manager, Solutions Architects for our Enterprise team in the San Francisco Bay area, you'll lead a distributed group of intermediate and senior Solutions Architects serving enterprise customers in the West sales territory. You'll guide your team to act as trusted advisors to GitLab prospects and customers, helping them validate GitLab's Enterprise Edition as the right technical and business solution and supporting successful adoption of the GitLab platform across the entire software development lifecycle. You'll hire, coach, and retain a high-performing team, set clear expectations, and be accountable for how your team runs complex technical evaluations, articulates business outcomes, and collaborates with Sales, Engineering, Product Management, and Marketing. You'll model the work of a Solutions Architect yourself, from solution design through technical presentations, so your team is equipped to drive meaningful customer change with GitLab.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Lead a distributed team of intermediate and senior Solutions Architects supporting Enterprise customers in the West territory.</li> <li value="2">Coach, mentor, and develop team members through regular feedback, career support, and skills development in both technical and consultative areas.</li> <li value="3">Grow and retain a high-performing team by hiring thoughtfully, onboarding effectively, and fostering an inclusive, results-focused culture.</li> <li value="4">Guide by example by engaging in key customer opportunities as a Solutions Architect, from discovery through technical validation and successful adoption of the GitLab platform.</li> <li value="5">Drive the quality and consistency of technical evaluations, demos, and proofs of concept so that GitLab solutions clearly address customer business and technical requirements.</li> <li value="6">Collaborate closely with regional sales managers on territory strategy, account planning, and forecast support to ensure alignment between technical and commercial motions.</li> <li value="7">Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to share field insights, influence the roadmap, and improve messaging around GitLab's Enterprise Edition and platform capabilities.</li> <li value="8">Own team execution by defining and tracking key performance indicators, and communicate progress, risks, and priorities clearly to your team, peers, and leadership.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Experience mentoring and developing technical team members, including giving and receiving constructive feedback.</li> <li value="2">Experience managing or leading technical pre-sales or information technology professionals, ideally in an enterprise-focused environment.</li> <li value="3">Ability to collaborate effectively with other managers and cross-functional partners to plan and execute sales and go-to-market strategies.</li> <li value="4">Strong technical presentation and communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders.</li> <li value="5">Knowledge of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern software development or operations practices.</li> <li value="6">Understanding of continuous integration and continuous deployment concepts and their impact on customer outcomes.</li> <li value="7">Familiarity with cloud computing concepts, related technologies, and common customer adoption patterns.</li> <li value="8">Ability and willingness to travel in line with business needs and the company's travel policy, and openness to learning and using GitLab and related tools, including through transferable experience from adjacent domains.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Enterprise Solutions Architect team partners with our largest customers to design and validate technical solutions that drive successful adoption of the GitLab platform. This role leads a group of intermediate and senior Solutions Architects aligned to the West Enterprise sales territory, working closely with Sales, Engineering, Product Management, and Marketing to support complex evaluations and long-term customer outcomes. We operate in a fully remote, asynchronous way across North America, using GitLab and our handbook-first approach to stay aligned on strategy, share technical best practices, and continuously improve how we support the sales cycle. Key opportunities for our team include deepening technical adoption of GitLab Enterprise Edition, connecting customer business goals with architectural recommendations, and serving as strong product advocates in the field.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Compensation Details </h2> <p>Please note this role can be filled at either the Manager or Senior Manager levels.   Details for base salary at the Manager level are listed below, but please note the OTE range for the Manager role is 205,600 - 308,400.  Additionally the base salary for the Senior Manager level is 186,600 - 279,900 and the OTE for the Senior Manager level is 248,800 - 373,200.   </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. title: Systems Engineer
description: 80-100% | as soon as possible | Germany or Switzerland About Exeon Exeon is a Swiss cyber security company based in Zurich. Since 2016, we have been protecting critical infrastructures, financial institutions and enterprises whose operations fully rely on IT through AI-powered analysis of network communication. This makes the most sophisticated cyberattacks visible – attacks conventional tools fail to detect. We combine Swiss excellence with a flexible, remote-first, and collaborative culture, supporting passionate, ambitious professionals devoted to solving cybersecurity challenges and driving continuous innovation. What your impact will be like: As a Systems Engineer in our Solutions team, you will help design the components and data flow of our core products: how data gets in, how deployments are configured and operated, and how everything scales across very different customer environments, many of them on-prem and air-gapped. You’ll split your time between building (ingestion pipelines, automation, tooling) and deploying and operating (working with customers to get Exeon running reliably in their environments), so your work shapes both scalability and customer success. In particular, you will: Build tooling and automation to simplify the deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management of Exeon.NDR, Exeon.UEBA, log collection and supporting components Design, build, and maintain scalable log ingestion pipelines for a wide range of network and application log sources and formats, including parsing, normalization, and validation Deploy and operate Exeon in customer environments (on-prem, private cloud, and hybrid), including sizing, performance tuning, and troubleshooting complex issues Work with customers to understand their data sources, infrastructure constraints, and security needs, and translate these into clear requirements for product and engineering teams Contribute to customer support, documentation, and runbooks alongside your Solutions colleagues What you can expect from us: Exeon offers an open company culture that values and encourages diversity, teamwork and a growth mindset. Our goal is to provide our employees with an exciting, supportive and motivating environment for personal growth and career development while ensuring that our team maintains a healthy work-life balance. We strive to achieve this by offering: An exciting and impactful job in a fast-growing Swiss cyber tech company expanding across Europe with manifold opportunities to shape your professional profile. Working in close collaboration with our interdisciplinary team and learning from our Security Experts, Data Scientists, and Business Professionals. Taking over responsibilities quickly and help shape and promote a cutting-edge security software. A high degree of trust, independence and flexibility, also in terms of working hours and place of work (remote or in the office). A competitive salary and appealing benefits package. What you bring along: We are looking for a proactive, self-motivated and enthusiastic cyber security professional who is comfortable in a high-paced start-up environment and who shares our values. You should be confident with solving problems independently and communicating easily with both internal teams and directly with customers. You should also: 3-5 years of experience in systems engineering, data engineering, platform/infrastructure engineering, or a similar role Working knowledge of network and application security and the telemetry relevant to detection UNIX/Linux experience, including networking, troubleshooting, and performance tuning in containerized deployments (Docker and/or Kubernetes) Strong programming skills in Python and Bash (or comparable languages), with a focus on automation and maintainable, production-quality code Hands-on experience designing and operating data ingestion pipelines (e.g. syslog, Logstash/Fluentd/Vector, Elastic stack, or similar), including handling heterogeneous formats and high volumes Comfortable with working in a largely remote team where clear communication is key to successful collaboration and impact. We are an English-speaking team but German fluency is appreciated when communicating to some customers Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience Nice to have: Solid understanding of network and application security fundamentals, common attack patterns, and the log and telemetry sources that matter for detection Experience with SIEM, SOAR, or detection platforms (e.g. Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic Security), or as a detection engineer or security analyst Familiarity with network telemetry such as NetFlow/IPFIX, Zeek, or Suricata, and frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK Prior customer-facing or professional services experience. description: Work with a Top 20 CPA and advisory firm that Accounts for Anything. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a SLED Solutions Architect, you'll be a trusted technical advisor to State, Local, and Education customers in every state east of the Mississippi River: state agencies, counties, cities, special districts, community colleges, and public, private, and research universities. These organizations deliver services residents and students rely on every day, often with lean IT teams, aging systems, fixed fiscal-year budgets, and growing cybersecurity threats.</p> <p>You'll show them how GitLab's DevSecOps platform and AI capabilities, including the GitLab Duo Agent Platform, help them modernize legacy applications, protect sensitive resident and student data, meet state and sector compliance requirements, and do more with the staff they have. You'll own the technical evaluation and validation stages of the sales cycle, guide customers through proofs of concept and value, and translate platform capabilities into outcomes that agency leaders, CIOs, CISOs, and procurement officers can defend in a budget request or an RFP evaluation.</p> <p>You'll partner closely with SLED account executives, channel partners, and systems integrators, provide technical guidance from first conversation through successful deployment, and bring the voice of the SLED customer back into Product, Sales, and Marketing.</p> <p><strong>Location and travel:</strong> The territory covers all states east of the Mississippi River. The candidate must reside in the Northeast part of the United States. This role requires up to 50% travel.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Engage SLED customers onsite and remotely, from state capitals to university campuses, with tailored demos, technical presentations, and hands-on workshops that tie GitLab to their mission.</li> <li>Partner with SLED account executives to shape account strategies that align with each customer's fiscal year budget cycle, legislative appropriations, IT modernization plans, and grant or federal pass through funding.</li> <li>Own the technical evaluation process, including proof of concept (POC) and proof of value (POV) design and delivery, and provide technical responses for RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, and security questionnaires.</li> <li>Support purchases made through cooperative purchasing agreements and statewide contract vehicles by working with channel and reseller partners.</li> <li>Guide customers through state and sector security requirements, such as GovRAMP and NIST frameworks, and show how GitLab's built in security, auditability, and deployment options reduce compliance burden.</li> <li>Help agencies and institutions modernize legacy and mainframe applications, such as unemployment insurance, tax, DMV, benefits, and student information systems, using GitLab and AI-assisted development to lower risk and offset shrinking pools of legacy skilled staff.</li> <li>Advise customers on adopting AI responsibly, including the GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in line with state AI policies, governance boards, and data privacy requirements.</li> <li>Lead the creation of Customer Success Plans that capture technical success criteria and handoff details, ensuring a smooth path to deployment and adoption, often for IT teams with limited capacity.</li> <li>Work alongside Account Executives to build data driven business cases that quantify delivery bottlenecks, giving customers a defensible basis for budget requests and clear evidence of return on taxpayer investment.</li> <li>Build relationships with CIOs, CISOs, agency directors, enterprise architects, faculty, research computing leaders, and procurement officers so they become advocates for GitLab, including across agencies and campuses that share services.</li> <li>Collaborate with systems integrators and state IT shared-services organizations to scale GitLab adoption across multiple agencies, local governments, or campuses.</li> <li>Serve as the SLED customer advocate internally, channeling feedback on procurement, compliance, and deployment needs to Product, Sales, and Marketing.</li> <li>Stay current on GitLab and related technologies, and create reusable SLED demos, reference architectures, and assets for customers and partners.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Background in technical pre-sales, consulting, or IT roles serving state agencies, local governments, or public, private, and research universities, where you guided customers through evaluations and solution design.</li> <li>Working knowledge of how SLED organizations buy technology: RFP and RFI cycles, cooperative purchasing agreements, statewide contracts, fiscal-year budgeting, and the role of resellers and systems integrators.</li> <li>Hands-on experience using GitLab and familiarity with modern software development and operations practices, such as CI/CD, DevSecOps, and automation.</li> <li>Experience with cloud, hybrid, and self-managed deployments in regulated environments, including government cloud regions, and an understanding of data residency and sovereignty concerns.</li> <li>Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks common in SLED, such as GovRAMP and NIST SP 800-53.</li> <li>Ability to connect technical solutions to mission outcomes, such as resident service delivery, cyber resilience, cost avoidance, and workforce efficiency, and to advise senior stakeholders on tradeoffs and options.</li> <li>Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including presenting to both technical teams and non-technical leaders such as agency heads, procurement officers, and university administrators.</li> <li>Openness to learning, seeking feedback, and building new skills, including familiarity with GitLab's Solutions Architect handbook and related resources.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience working in or for state or local government IT, or a university IT or research computing organization.</li> <li>Experience with legacy or mainframe modernization programs.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI governance practices in the public sector, such as AI use-case inventories, acceptable-use policies, and risk assessments.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The SLED Solutions Architect role is part of GitLab's Public Sector Solutions Architect team, a group of trusted technical advisors who help government and education customers understand, evaluate, and adopt the GitLab DevSecOps platform. The team is distributed and collaborates asynchronously across time zones using GitLab and our handbook-first practices to share knowledge, reusable examples, and best practices.</p> <p>On the SLED team, you'll help customers solve challenges unique to state, local, and education organizations: protecting resident and student data, modernizing mission-critical legacy systems, buying through public procurement processes, and stretching limited IT staff and budgets. description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re seeking a Customer Solutions Architect (CSA) to help drive the adoption of Supabase across a diverse range of customers: from agile startups building towards their first launch to established brands with highly scaled workloads. At Supabase, CSA’s are responsible for the entire customer journey, working closely with our most valuable users to: 1. Uncover and understand business and technical requirements. 2. Design and architect technical solutions built on the Supabase platform. 3. Work with customers to lead proof-of-value implementations. 4. Provide regular customer engagements to answer complex questions, unblock adoption, and optimize scaled performance. Successful CSAs always put customers first, working closely with them to become trusted advisors who understand their needs, work as an extension of their team toward common success, and advocate on behalf of the customer within Supabase. You'll be joining our team to support Supabase Team & Enterprise customers, where you will be expected to lead and innovate around the following areas of responsibility: DISCOVERY - Lead technical discovery to uncover business and technical objectives, set appropriate expectations of the Supabase platform, and define the criteria for success, ensuring customers can receive the guidance they need to achieve it. - Design, build, and present Supabase platform demonstrations to high-value customers. Leverage quality storytelling to present the value of the Supabase platform and of the entire Supabase Success team. - Work directly with Growth team members to size deals, provide anticipated usage estimates, and identify potential workloads supported by the Platform. PROOF-OF-VALUE ONBOARDING - Collaborate directly with customers to determine the technical scope of a proof-of-value to ensure customers recognize the value of the Supabase platform while minimizing risk to adoption. - Set proof-of-value timelines, business outcomes, and success criteria that ensure a customer is comfortable proceeding with the platform once a proof-of-value has been completed. - Actively guide new customers through an onboarding journey, utilizing emails, docs, guides, and webinars to promote their rapid deployment and growth on the platform. CUSTOMER SUCCESS - Understand immediate custom goals (i.e onboard and adoption) as well as long-term customer opportunities (i.e. optimization & identifying new workloads) to build meaningful account plans for high-value customers. - Deliver on synchronous and asynchronous engagements with Supabase customers, including application architecture assessments, database design and performance optimization, and proactive support to enable customers to scale with confidence. - Serve as an internal champion for your customers and for the platform. Work closely with Support, Product, and Engineering to provide platform feedback, identify areas of improvement, while communicating platform roadmaps to customers. - Invest in customer connections to build a trust-based relationship. Everyday CSA’s work with the production data stores of startups and enterprises alike. Building trust in the Success team and Supabase platform is paramount to a successful customer relationship. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE - 6+ years of relevant work experience in Solutions Architecture, Database Engineering, or similar. - Strong background with relational database management systems such as PostgreSQL or MySQL. - Background in web application development, with familiarity with Python, C# and popular JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue, Svelte) as well as Node.js. - Very strong communication skills, particularly of technical concepts. CSA’s at Supabase spend a significant amount of time translating business needs to technical outcomes, and technical concepts to organizational impact. - Well-organized and effective storyteller with meaningful interpersonal skills. CSA’s often have to navigate multiple stakeholders with conflicting opinions, and the ability to effectively mediate this type of conflict is crucial. - Experience with project management, business analysis and revenue operations tools. We use HubSpot, BigQuery etc., and familiarity with these platforms will help enable your success. - Previous experience leading customer-facing engagements to deliver meaningful technical and business value. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Corporate Development Director
location: Remote Ireland; Remote, France; Remote, Germany; Remote, Israel; Remote, Netherlands; Remote, Spain; Remote, United Kingdom
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2 id="an-overview-of-this-role" data-lfile-container="21ea07e5-ded4-47e8-ad92-4ca7b7d6be35" data-pm-slice="1 1 []">An overview of this role</h2> <p>As the Corporate Development Director, you'll help influence how GitLab invests to win: what we build, what we buy, where we partner, and what we should not pursue. This role sits within the Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships team, reporting to the VP, Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships.</p> <p>This role straddles strategy and M&A engagements. You'll lead research that frames GitLab's options: mapping the markets in and around our AI-powered DevSecOps platform, testing where we have a right to win, and turning that into clear recommendations for the executive team. When the answer is to acquire, you'll drive the deal process end to end, from outreach through close and integration.</p> <p>Success here is not measured by deal count. It looks like sharper strategic choices: a well-reasoned point of view on our priority markets, investment theses that product and executive leaders rely on, acquisitions that speed up the roadmap when buying is the right answer, and an educated no when it isn't. You'll own the wider market perspective rather than individual product categories, and work with the team's Analyst on the research behind it.</p> <h2 id="what-youll-do">What you'll do</h2> <h3 id="strategy-and-research">Strategy and research</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own the wider market view.</strong> Research the broader market GitLab competes in, beyond specific product categories: competitive dynamics, AI-native entrants, technology shifts and where value is moving. Collaborate with the team's Analyst on the research and turn the findings into a clear point of view on where GitLab should play.</li> <li><strong>Build an investment thesis for each focus area.</strong> Work with Product and Engineering leaders to define the problems worth solving, the capabilities GitLab needs, and what it would cost in time and money to get there on our own.</li> <li><strong>Own the competitive and landscape view.</strong> Maintain market maps and a current read on GitLab's competitors: their strategy, product direction, positioning, pricing, and M&A and funding activity. Produce competitor analyses that show where we lead, where we're exposed and how rivals are likely to move. Flag shifts by competitors, hyperscalers and AI labs that change our options, and bring the implications to Product and the executive team.</li> <li><strong>Define where GitLab should not play.</strong> Identify adjacencies that dilute focus and markets where the economics or competition work against us. Make the case for a no with the same rigor as a yes.</li> </ul> <h3 id="build-buy-or-partner">Build, buy or partner</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Run the build, buy, partner analysis.</strong> For each strategic gap, compare the options side by side on speed, cost, risk, control and strategic fit, and bring a clear recommendation.</li> <li><strong>Deliver strategic clarity to</strong> <strong>executives and the Board.</strong> Produce short strategy memos/decks and business cases that set out the decision, the trade-offs and what we give up with each path.</li> <li><strong>Feed company strategy and planning.</strong> Bring an outside-in view of the market and the inorganic options available into annual and long-range planning.</li> <li><strong>Work hand in hand with Strategic Partnerships.</strong> When partnering is the right answer, frame the opportunity and hand it to the partnership owner with a clear thesis. When it isn't, explain why.</li> </ul> <h3 id="deal-execution-and-integration">Deal execution and integration</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own end-to-end deal process management.</strong> Validate target fit against GitLab's our target profile, product roadmap and other criteria, and build the acquisition rationale and business case. Drive our M&A process from intro call through the various steps through to closing and integration.</li> <li><strong>Evaluate the deal.</strong> Develop valuation, commercial integrity assessment, impact on GitLab's business and provide negotiations assistance to the VP and the executive team.</li> <li><strong>Lead cross-functional diligence.</strong> Run pre-LOI validation and diligence across Product, Engineering, Security, Finance, Legal and People, and communicate findings clearly.</li> <li><strong>Drive deal documents with Legal.</strong> Prepare NDAs, LOIs and purchase agreements with GitLab Legal and outside counsel.</li> <li><strong>Own integration outcomes.</strong> Lead post-acquisition integration as the DRI, measured against the roadmap and business goals in the business case. Bring lessons learned back into the strategy work.</li> <li><strong>Build the external network.</strong> Maintain relationships with founders, executives, investors, bankers and advisors that bring us early insight and pipeline.</li> </ul> <h2 id="what-youll-bring">What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy and deal experience.</strong> 8+ years across corporate development, corporate strategy, strategy consulting or technology investing, including 5+ years leading acquisitions end to end in enterprise software.</li> <li><strong>Structured strategic thinking.</strong> You form a point of view from incomplete information, test it against data, and change your mind when the evidence says so. You're as comfortable recommending that we stay out of a market as that we enter it.</li> <li><strong>Market research depth.</strong> Skilled in market sizing, competitive analysis and landscape mapping, and in turning research into a recommendation, not a report.</li> <li><strong>Deal craft.</strong> Skilled in valuation, financial modeling, deal structuring, negotiation and integration planning, with experience across varied consideration structures.</li> <li><strong>Technical fluency.</strong> A working understanding of software development, DevSecOps and the AI landscape, enough to hold substantive conversations with product and engineering leaders about roadmaps and architecture.</li> <li><strong>Clear executive communication.</strong> You write short, decision-ready updates and present trade-offs plainly to executives and the Board, in an async-first environment.</li> <li><strong>Influence without authority.</strong> You build trust across Product, Engineering, Finance and Legal and move decisions forward across functions.</li> <li><strong>Ownership with collaboration.</strong> You own the strategic view and the recommendation, and partner closely with the team's Analyst on research and analysis.</li> <li><strong>Preferred:</strong> familiarity with the DevSecOps, security, AI and open source ecosystems.</li> <li>You value the <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/all-remote/" target="_blank">all remote</a> lifestyle and share our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/values/" target="_blank">values</a>.</li> </ul> <h2 id="about-the-team">About the team</h2> <p>The Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships team helps GitLab decide how to grow beyond what we build on our own. We own inorganic strategy: acquisitions, strategic partnerships with hyperscalers and AI labs, and the research that tells us which to pursue and which to pass on.</p> <p>We work across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal and the executive group. We set direction and do the detailed work ourselves, with a high degree of ownership and transparency in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after start

title: Senior Ecosystem Operations Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Ecosystem Operations Manager at GitLab, you'll own the technology, processes, and operational infrastructure behind our channel, distribution, original equipment manufacturer (OEM), global systems integrator (GSI), and managed service provider (MSP) partnerships. You'll shape how our partners go to market, serving as the primary process owner for deal registration, partner programs, partner quote-to-cash, and partner attribution. You'll combine operational strategy with hands-on execution, using artificial intelligence (AI) to automate workflows and help ecosystem operations scale.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design and govern end-to-end partner processes, including deal and referral registration, service attach, two-tier distribution, rules of engagement, and quote-to-cash. Partner with Deal Desk and Billing on resale, distribution, OEM, GSI, and MSP transaction workflows, and resolve complex registration, quoting, and billing escalations.</li> <li>Own operational execution of partner tiering, onboarding, certification compliance, not-for-resale (NFR) licenses, rebates, and incentives, including eligibility tracking, approval routing, and payments.</li> <li>Own and administer the partner technology ecosystem, including Impartner partner relationship management (PRM), Salesforce customer relationship management (CRM) partner objects, deal registration, and partner portals. Maintain system health and data integrity, and co-manage vendor roadmaps, renewals, and service-level accountability.</li> <li>Partner with Revenue Technologies and Systems to maintain integrations across partner platforms, Salesforce, enterprise resource planning (ERP), quoting, billing, and financial systems, including partner attribution and compensation data flows. Lead prioritization and user acceptance testing (UAT) for implementations, migrations, and platform enhancements with IT and Enterprise Applications.</li> <li>Own the ecosystem data model and work toward one standard partner attribution record across the customer lifecycle. Serve as a resource for Ecosystem Sales, partners, and internal teams on attribution, territory, and compensation-impacting data, and maintain reporting and dashboards as a single source of truth for partner pipeline, registration activity, and program performance.</li> <li>Lead ecosystem month-end close with Deal Desk, Compensation, Accounts Receivable, and Finance, covering opportunity corrections, partner splits, territory review, and reconciliation.</li> <li>Identify, build, and deploy AI agents to automate workflows such as deal registration routing, NFR provisioning, partner data quality checks, and reporting. Evaluate processes for opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and shorten cycle times.</li> <li>Maintain the authoritative ecosystem process map, runbooks, and training materials. Support tool configuration, testing, and end-user training. Own channel price files and partner quoting for product launches and stock keeping unit (SKU) changes. Coordinate improvements with operational peers, IT, Finance, Product, and Legal through GitLab Work Items.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience in business-to-business software-as-a-service channel or partner operations, with direct ownership of ecosystem workflows and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Impartner or an equivalent PRM platform, including deal registration and partner portal administration.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of Salesforce CRM, including partner objects, opportunity management, Flow, validation rules, reports, and dashboards.</li> <li>Deep familiarity with resale, two-tier distribution, deal registration, rules of engagement, partner discounting, and partner quote-to-cash, plus an understanding of OEM, GSI, and MSP transaction structures and operational requirements.</li> <li>Direct experience operating partner programs, including tiering, certification compliance, rebates, and incentives, with responsibility for execution and compliance.</li> <li>Experience designing and documenting complex operational processes for distributed teams, translating business needs into detailed system requirements and configuration, and leading user acceptance testing through release.</li> <li>Hands-on experience using AI tools and building agents to automate operational workflows, from evaluating opportunities to delivering working solutions.</li> <li>Experience resolving ambiguous operational escalations across systems, teams, and partner relationships, and aligning Deal Desk, IT, Finance, Compensation, Legal, and Sales around operational changes.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>Our Ecosystem Operations team works closely with Systems, Revenue Technologies, Deal Desk, Ecosystem Programs, Enablement, Finance, Compensation, and Legal. We enable consistent execution across Ecosystem Operations Specialists and cross-functional partners. You'll also partner with the Senior Hyperscaler Operations Manager, who owns Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud operations, on shared systems, the ecosystem data model, and month-end close.</p> <h4><br><br></h4><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
description: <p>The Canonical Security Operations team is hiring for a Senior or Staff engineer. The Security Operations team is responsible for designing, building, and operating a world-class Security Operations Center, and the successful candidate will provide leadership, mentorship, expertise, and outstanding individual contributions towards those ends.</p> <p>This role involves aspects of:</p> <ul> <li>Traditional SOC duties - security monitoring, threat hunting, and response.</li> <li>Security engineering - assessing and protecting Canonical platforms and products.</li> <li>Software engineering - building custom tools and platforms.</li> <li>Site reliability engineering - deploying, maintaining, and automating security tools.</li> </ul> <p>We are looking for individuals with engineering and security experience, as well as a history of remarkable achievement. Senior security operations personnel with engineering experience and senior developers with security experience are equally well-suited to this role.</p> <p>Beyond securing Canonical’s digital estate, this position represents a unique opportunity to contribute to the open source ecosystem. Team members may present at industry conferences, share threat intelligence with the wider community, or publish open source security software.</p> <p><em>Junior positions are also available for less-experienced individuals with a compelling academic or professional background.</em></p> <h2><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Provide operational and engineering leadership.</li> <li>Implement and evolve Canonical’s Security Operations Center.</li> <li>Design and develop security software and platforms.</li> <li>Monitor for, identify, respond to, and remediate security incidents.</li> <li>Assess and improve Canonical’s security controls.</li> <li>Mentor early-career Security Operations engineers.</li> <li>Plan and deliver work within Canonical's agile engineering framework.</li> <li>Contribute to open source security.</li> <li>Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We are looking for:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record.</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path.</li> <li>10+ years of relevant professional experience</li> <li>Professional cybersecurity experience, preferably working or leading a Security Operations Center.</li> <li>Professional engineering experience.</li> <li>An eagerness to contribute to open source security.</li> <li>Proficiency in common scripting languages, such as Python and Bash.</li> <li>Knowledge of Git, GitOps, Infrastructure-as-Code, and common orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes)</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Though optional, we value:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Familiarity with security frameworks such as the NIST CSF, CIS CSC, and ISO 27001</li> <li>Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools.</li> <li>Experience in a security operations team or a security operations center.</li> <li>Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability.</li> <li>Experience with advanced persistent threats.</li> <li>Proficiency in additional programming languages, such as Golang.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer you:</strong></h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About Canonical</strong></h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h2><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p>

title: Staff Security Operations Engineer
description: <p>We have opened several senior/staff Security Operations Engineer (SOC) positions, creating a new team reporting to the CISO. We are looking for a range of experience in these positions - at the high end we are looking for deep experience defending highly contested critical assets and high-value cyber targets against advanced persistent threats and state-level actors. We have more junior roles for exceptional individuals with a proven personal interest an engagement in cyber attack and defence, and outstanding academic and career performance even if experience is limited.</p> <p>Our goal is to build an entirely new level of assurance and observable rigour into the open source supply chain. We have our own estate to monitor, but more broadly our goal is to raise the robustness of the entire global Ubuntu estate through the work of this team.</p> <p>The Security Operations (SecOps) team is responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>As a Contract Talent Acquisition Sourcer at GitLab, you'll help build strong candidate pipelines for our sales team in the APJ region in a fully remote, distributed company. month contract. </p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Source, screen and engage passive candidates for sales roles across the APJ region using LinkedIn, online research, and other hiring managers to understand role requirements, business priorities, and ideal candidate profiles.</li> <li>Map talent markets and gather intelligence on competitors, locations, and candidate pools candidates, building and maintaining talent benches across multiple countries in the APJ region to ensure strong pipeline depth and readiness for evolving business needs.</li> <li>Deliver a strong candidate experience through thoughtful outreach, timely communication, and professional relationship building.</li> <li>Continuously improve sourcing workflows, outreach approaches, and research methods to increase efficiency and quality.</li> <li>Maintain accurate activity and candidate data in applicant tracking and recruiting systems, and stay open to learning new tools and processes.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Relevant experience in recruiting and/or sourcing, including direct experience sourcing passive candidates in a fully outbound managing multiple searches, deadlines, and competing priorities.</li> <li>Familiarity with applicant tracking systems and recruiting tools. The team values clear communication, strong market insight, and steady iteration in how we work. This role is especially important as GitLab continues to grow go-to-market teams in APJ, where strong regional knowledge and effective collaboration across time zones can help teams hire with more focus and confidence.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement.
